title: Unicode-safe String indices
summary: Walk a String with String.Index and return a Character without assuming integer or byte offsets.
code: func character(at offset: Int, in text: String) -> Character? {
triggers: access a user-perceived character by an offset that may be out of bounds
prompts: Safely select a displayed character from text containing emoji and combining marks.
invariant: Only a valid character index before endIndex is used for subscripting.
mantra: Advance with String.Index; never subscript endIndex.
pitfalls: String indices are not integer byte offsets.
Walking to an offset takes linear time; repeated offset lookups can become quadratic.
